voices.note: the mishna כל הקדשים שקדם מום קבוע להקדשן (14a.1-4), cited out of span

props.gloss_en: the mishna: all consecrated animals whose permanent blemish preceded their consecration, and which were redeemed, are obligated in the firstborn [law] and in the gifts
the reason is that they were redeemed; but if they were not redeemed, they are exempt from the firstborn [law] and from the gifts
he [the tanna] holds: sanctity of value pushes [the animal] off from the firstborn [law] and from the gifts

supports.gloss_en: טעמא דנפדו, הא לא נפדו -- from the mishna's 'and were redeemed': unredeemed, they are exempt
קסבר -- from the exemption of the unredeemed animal the stam reads the tanna's principle: sanctity of value pushes off from the firstborn and the gifts
